name: Broken Lamp Records Secret Santa 2025
summary: BLRSS2025 is a compilation of 17 gift maps by Broken Lamp Records, a mapping team of mainly weird transfems/enbies/therians with a bunch of eclectic tastes in doom. Each mapper posted a prompt of what they like in a map, then were arranged in a loop and had to map for the next person down based on their prompt, while being secretly mapped for by the next person up.
